Kelly Loo is a current master's student in Environmental Data Science at the Bren School of Environmental Science and Management at University of California, Santa Barbara. Her interests lie in natural disasters and hazards. Outside of school, Kelly enjoys crocheting, playing frisbee, or reading.

B.S. Geoscience | University of California, San Diego
